pages.text: $(#BA55D3)🦋 Void Butterfly Waltz · Weightless Ballad 🌌$()$(br2)$(l)$(#9370DB)「Those who sip this stardust nectar may briefly inherit the flight of the Ender Butterfly」$()$(br)The illusionary glow of $(#BA55D3)Gaura$(), the airy lightness of $(#FFD700)Star Sugar Crystals$(), the void properties of $(#B0C4DE)Phantom Wing Membrane$(), and the spatial essence of $(#9370DB)Chorus Extract$() resonate within the $(#4B0082)End Stone Mortar$()—a forbidden levitation elixir capable of $(l)momentarily negating gravity$().

$(#9370DB)▌ Triple Phantom Waltz $()$(br2)$(l)$(#B0C4DE)🪶 Void Butterfly Wings$()$(br)Surrounds the body with $(#E6E6FA)semi-transparent butterfly scales$(), enabling floating.$(br2)$(l)$(#BA55D3)🌀 Stardust Slowfall$()$(br)Releases $(#9370DB)purple star rings$() when falling, reducing speed.$(br2)$(l)$(#7CFC00)🐇 Lunar Leap$()$(br)Jumping height surpasses $(#32CD32)ordinary limits$().

$(br2)$(#4B0082)▌ Ender Brewing Process $()$(br)- Extract $(#9370DB)Gaura$()’s $(#FF69B4)rosy-violet glow$() using $(#9370DB)Chorus Flowers$().$(br)- Fold $(#B0C4DE)Phantom Wing Membrane$() into a $(#E6E6FA)paper crane$() shape and soak it.$(br)- When adding $(#FFD700)Star Sugar Crystals$(), stir in an $(#BA55D3)infinity-symbol$() motion.$(br2)$(#00BFFF)※$() A successful brew will display $(#9370DB)butterfly wing light patterns$() and $(#B0C4DE)void particles$().

$(br2)$(#6A5ACD)『 Astronomer’s Journal 』$()$(br)An inscription found in an End City stone tablet:$(br)'This drink fuses:$(br)- The dreamlike glow of $(#BA55D3)Gaura$()$(br)- The weightlessness of $(#B0C4DE)Phantom Wings$()$(br)- The spatial awareness of $(#9370DB)Chorus Extract$()$(br)The drinker shall waltz through the air like an $(#E6E6FA)Ender Dragon$(),$(br)but must land before the $(#FFD700)Star Sugar Glow$() fades,$(br)lest they activate the $(#4B0082)Void Vortex$()'s $(#000000)consumption protocol$()'.
